answer: Witnessed pulse triangulation. Each identity must answer timed challenge pulses routed through three independent relay nodes and return a crystal signed digest. Relays record arrival deltas; a node in a canyon of latency margins cannot fake concurrent presence for many identities from one host. Attacker cost: one physically distinct relay path and clock domain per identity, roughly a dedicated machine and network line, making each sybil cost real hardware rather than a database row.
